items.title: Strengthened activity evidence workflows
items.summary: Improved backend activity evidence handling with clearer attribution, reconciliation, and deterministic timestamps.

items.title: Introduced consent-first health setup
items.summary: Improved the health integration experience with provider-neutral onboarding and clearer consent-led setup flows.

items.title: Clarified cross-domain ownership boundaries
items.summary: Documented and enforced clearer ownership contracts across backend modules and persistence boundaries.

items.title: Hardened provider data lifecycles
items.summary: Made provider disconnect and synchronization behavior safer by tightening derived-data handling and removing obsolete integration paths.

items.title: Improved canonical shoe matching
items.summary: Added exact and fuzzy matching behavior for canonical shoes and organized its behavioral test coverage.

items.title: Refined app settings and support flows
items.summary: Updated account, settings, support, and shoe workflows while aligning the app with its current design direction.
